title: Do you feat T.G.I. Free
description: “Do You” is a soulful, resilient anthem about staying true to yourself when life tries to reshape you. Miycho and T.G.I. FREE reflect on pressure, setbacks, and the weight of expectations—but never losing their identity in the process. It’s honest, uplifting, and grounded in self-belief, reminding you to move your own way no matter what comes your way.
